beats.text: A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Valeria drew giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
👁 It hears you coming mid-wingbeat — in the air, you don't catch it. Hunt it roosting at dawn, or wait for the water it must come down to.
"The sick need tending — triage tents, broth, boiled water. Or we tighten our belts and wait it out. Or the hale hunt while the sick lie still."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
You lay out the haul. A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame leans over giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk. "Oh — THAT one. Here, look."
💡 You see it again in your mind: giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk. your teacher's words land on the memory like a label. Burdock. Of course.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
The Mountain Lord stalks closer. A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy.
